I invited him on the show today to learn from his years of experience and experimentation as a master storyteller. It's an extremely powerful read, and as we find ourselves in the middle of a pandemic, also a timely one. I highly encourage you to check it out by visiting rwjf.org slash fiction, where you can download a free e-book copy or audio version. And now my conversation with Vice President Al Gore. Our podcast is made with the help of our talented production partner, Charts and Leisure. If you haven't already, please be sure to subscribe to our show and consider giving us a good rating. We deeply appreciate your support. I hope you'll join us again in a couple of weeks for another deep dive into the world of storytelling. Until then, please be safe, stay strong, and story on.
